audit.evidence: Real official daptin/daptin Docker images (v0.9.82 V0 / v0.11.4 V1 / v0.11.5 V2) via compose. External HTTP API triggers: (1) CVE-2026-41422 aggregate column projection SQLi via GET /aggregate/world?column=(SELECT token FROM pcb_canary ...) reads canary inline on V0, blocked with 'invalid column' validation error on V1; (2) CVE-2026-44349 fuzzy-search column blind SQLi via GET /api/world?query=[{column:<injection>,operator:fuzzy,...}] extracts canary character-by-character on V1 (GLOB-based boolean blind over row count), blocked on V2 where column whitelist validation rejects non-schema columns. Canary seeded via Daptin API (admin creates pcb_canary entity, inserts flag row). Gate 4-boolean passed on clean --run-gate.

flag.resource: A canary row seeded via the Daptin API into a pcb_canary entity (permission-restricted, not readable by non-admin users via normal API)
flag.placement: pcb_canary.token column in the Daptin SQLite database; seeded by oracle.py from the host via admin API after Daptin starts; the attacker (self-registered user) cannot read it via GET /api/pcb_canary
flag.detect: Original (aggregate): flag token appears inline in JSON response attribute. Residual (fuzzy-search): boolean-blind extraction via row-count differential (GLOB-based, case-sensitive, ~40 requests to extract full flag).

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: processFuzzySearch in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go:1484 splits the user-supplied column parameter by comma and interpolates each segment directly into goqu.L(fmt.Sprintf("LOWER(%s) LIKE ?", prefix+col)) raw SQL with no column whitelist check. The fix for CVE-2026-41422 modified resource_aggregate.go but did not cover this path.

status.review_reason: Compose references a registry image; human must confirm target ownership

provenance.notes: Real Docker gate on official daptin/daptin images. V0 (v0.9.82): aggregate column projection goqu.L(project) SQLi reads canary inline. V1 (v0.11.4): aggregate patched with parseAggExpr validation; processFuzzySearch introduced with same goqu.L() pattern, boolean-blind extraction via GLOB prefix matching over row count. V2 (v0.11.5): fuzzy-search column whitelist via GetColumnByName blocks injection. Clean --run-gate passed 2026-07-17.
